definition: Mistral Vibe or Vibe (Le Chat until May 2026) is a chatbot that uses generative artificial intelligence developed in France by Mistral AI.
details: Mistral Vibe is available in iOS and Android. Its services are operated on a freemium model.

explainer.lead: Mistral Vibe, called Le Chat until May 2026, is a French generative-AI chatbot from Mistral AI available on iOS and Android. It matters as Mistral's consumer-facing entry point to its models.

tiers.eli5: It's a chat app from a French AI company, like a European answer to the big American chatbots, free to use with a paid tier.
tiers.practitioner: Teams integrate it where they want a hosted assistant with European provenance; a pitfall is that its name and features have changed repeatedly, so documentation and links go stale.
tiers.paperLevel: It is a chatbot using generative AI, offered on a freemium model with a Pro tier at $14.99 per month; no formal technical specification is given.

explainer.example: A user can query AFP's archive back to 1983 through the chatbot under a January 2025 content deal, or pay $14.99 monthly for Pro.
